grammar.section: GRAMMAR IN USE · WHAT DO YOU DO?
grammar.explanation: Dùng 'What do you do?' để hỏi về nghề nghiệp. Trả lời: 'I'm a [job].' hoặc 'I work as a [job].' Dùng 'Where do you work?' để hỏi nơi làm việc. Trả lời: 'I work in/at a [place].'
grammar.explanationVi: Dùng 'What do you do?' để hỏi về nghề nghiệp. Trả lời: 'I'm a [job].' hoặc 'I work as a [job].' Dùng 'Where do you work?' để hỏi nơi làm việc. Trả lời: 'I work in/at a [place].'
lines: What do you do? — I'm a teacher.
What do you do? — I work as an engineer.
Where do you work? — I work in an office.
Where do you work? — I work at a hospital.
Do you like your job? — Yes, I do.
commonMistakes: Sai: 'What is your job?' (ít dùng) → Phổ biến: 'What do you do?'
Sai: 'I am teacher.' → Đúng: 'I am a teacher.' (cần mạo từ a/an)
Sai: 'I work in hospital.' → Đúng: 'I work at a hospital.' hoặc 'I work in a hospital.'

grammar.explanation: Dùng thì hiện tại đơn để mô tả công việc và thói quen làm việc. Thêm 's' cho he/she/it. Dùng 'every day', 'usually', 'sometimes' để nói về tần suất.
grammar.explanationVi: Dùng thì hiện tại đơn để mô tả công việc và thói quen làm việc. Thêm 's' cho he/she/it. Dùng 'every day', 'usually', 'sometimes' để nói về tần suất.
lines: He drives a bus every day.
commonMistakes: Sai: 'She teach English.' → Đúng: 'She teaches English.'
Sai: 'He drive a bus.' → Đúng: 'He drives a bus.'
Sai: 'I starts work at 8.' → Đúng: 'I start work at 8.'

reading.title: A Day in the Life of a Nurse
reading.text: My name is Hoa. I am a nurse. I work at a hospital. I start work at 7am and finish at 3pm. I work five days a week. I don't work on weekends. My job is busy but I love it. I help doctors and take care of patients. Sometimes patients are sad or in pain. I try to make them feel better. In the evening, I go home and rest. I cook dinner for my family. I go to bed at 10pm. I think nursing is a good job because you help people every day.

questions.q: What time does Hoa start work?

writing.template: I am a ___. I work/study at ___. I start at ___. I like my job/studies because ___.
checklist: Did you mention your job or studies?
Did you mention where you work/study?
Did you mention what time you start?
Did you mention why you like it?
